description: Sri Lanka Customs - The Rates of Exchange effective from 26.03.2018 to 01.04.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically modifying how financial calculations are performed for import/export duties. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
